what_happened: In job qy2p, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The job adds a "recurring failure classes" section to agent briefs. The first reading put it in the planner and critic briefs. Job planning is now switched off (athena.toml [job_plan] enabled = false, landed in f80b05a), so those briefs never run. The user moved the section to the producer brief, because the reader brief has no token room. The threshold, cap and data quoting stay the same. The producer budget test must still pass. The planner and critic briefs must not change.
cause: The reading is built from the request text and is not checked against the live config. Nothing records which pipeline roles are enabled or which briefs have token room before the reading picks where text goes. A switch such as [job_plan] enabled = false changes which briefs matter, but the reading stage does not see it. Only the user, who made the change, knew that the planner and critic no longer run. The earlier case 6kt2 shares part of this gap: the reading is not compared with the current repo and config state. The class is new because the wrong choice here is the target role, not a missing prior-attempt result or a wrong deliverable.
prevention: Add a check before a reading is accepted. For each agent brief or role named as a place to add or change text, resolve it against athena.toml and confirm the role is enabled. If it is disabled, flag it and name the enabled roles that read the same kind of content. For a prompt edit, the check should also report the remaining token budget of the candidate briefs. A reading that targets a disabled role, or a brief without room, would then be sent back before the user sees it.
proposed_request: Add a "recurring failure classes" section to the producer brief. It must use the same threshold, cap and data quoting as the original request for this feature. Do not put it in the reader brief, which has no token room. Do not change the planner or critic briefs, because job planning is off ([job_plan] enabled = false, landed in f80b05a). Keep the producer budget test passing, and add a test that the producer brief contains the section and that the planner and critic briefs are unchanged. Before dispatch, check that every role the reading names as a target is enabled in athena.toml and has token room for the added text.
